name: sao-aincrad
description: Run persistent Sword Art Online Aincrad campaigns through one authoritative runtime line and one System Menu UI.

interface.shortDescription: Aincrad runtime with internal GATE and one System Menu
interface.longDescription: A persistent Aincrad runtime whose ordinary gameplay mutations all pass through one fixed server-owned GATE/runline and refresh one player-visible System Menu.
defaultPrompt: Continue my Aincrad campaign through the runtime and show the System Menu after state changes.
